Read the full FAQ on GitHub
Can it transcribe calls or meetings?
No. Android blocks recording the call audio of other apps, and anti-vocale only receives what you share to it. For meetings, record the audio with any recorder, then share the file.
Parakeet is the default: fast and accurate on clean voice messages. For other languages pick a model that covers yours from the Models tab; bigger models are slower on older phones.
Requests run one at a time in order of arrival. Share another voice note while one is processing and it waits its turn; the notification shows the queue position.
What do the result details mean?
Each entry keeps the model used, duration, and processing time. Long-press an entry to retry, copy, delete, or report a bad result by email.

If a result never arrives, the phone maker may have frozen the app in the background: check the battery-settings advice in the error notification. A failed result keeps a report entry with everything needed to diagnose it.
